blocks.text: PARIS — France’s foreign minister on Tuesday accused billionaire tycoon Elon Musk, owner of the social media platform X, of engaging in “online harassment” of European leaders, as he warned of the risk of interference in France’s 2027 presidential election. Jean-Noel Barrot warned that ahead of the April-May election — in which far-right candidate Marine Le Pen has her strongest chance yet of winning the presidency — “the enemies of democracy will do everything to destabilise us.” “They exploit our divisions and exploit issues such as immigration, secularism and the Israeli-Palestinian conflict to stoke hatred and tension,” he said at a […]...
